text:
leo-customer: Hey team, Acme reported their March 12 invoice shows token usage basically doubled for a spike around 2025-03-12 10:12 UTC. Invoice link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/ACME-20250312 

ara-support: Thanks Leo — can you paste a couple of the request IDs and a minimal repro? Also did they use mobile SDK or server-side?

leo-customer: They say mobile SDK Android v2.4.1 and our backend proxy (customer edge) in front of Redwood. Request IDs: r_3A9f2 and r_3A9f3. Example log snippet they gave:

```
> Outgoing to api.redwood: POST /v1/chat/completions
> x-idempotency-key: 9f8b7c6a-001
> content-length: 135824
> status: 200
> tokens: 1,234
```

ara-support: Ok - initial hypothesis: retries from mobile SDK + idempotency header not preserved somewhere. Jamie, can you check ingress logs for those request IDs and whether x-idempotency-key made it to the backend?

jamie-eng: digging in. pulled logs across the edge and app-tier for r_3A9f2/r_3A9f3. Interesting: ingress (api-gw-1) received x-idempotency-key and forwarded upstream, but the conn tracked in app-proxy shows forwarded request with no x-idempotency-key header for the second attempt. I can repro locally when payload >128k.

mike-sre: dev note: we rolled api-gateway 1.3.7 two days ago that changed header folding behavior to reduce memory copying. suspect regression.

leo-customer: So they got charged twice because backend treated retry as a new request?

ara-support: Looks like it. Ledger shows two usage events for same user/timestamp with distinct server_event_ids. billing-bot help: invoice/ledger evidence?

billing-bot: Invoice ACME-20250312 shows two entries at 10:12:07 and 10:12:09 for chat.completions, tokens 1,234 and 1,230, total 2,464. Ledger query id: Q_875321.

jamie-eng: Repro steps I used: curl to /v1/chat/completions with --data-binary of ~140k payload and header X-Idempotency-Key: 9f8b7c6a-001 then simulate a retry by closing the client socket after sending body but before reading response. When retrying, gateway sometimes strips the header due to folded header chunk being parsed into multiple header frames; internal proxy incorrectly dropped unknown folded header. Backend sees no idempotency key and processes as new.

```
# repro (local)
printf '\n' > /tmp/payload.json
dd if=/dev/urandom bs=1 count=140000 >> /tmp/payload.json
curl -v -H "X-Idempotency-Key: 9f8b7c6a-001" --data-binary @/tmp/payload.json https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions
# kill client mid-response and retry with same header
```

ara-support: That matches the customer environment (mobile SDK + flaky cell network). The mobile SDK will retry on timeouts with same idempotency key, expecting server dedupe. If header is dropped mid-route, server treats as new.

mike-sre: Root cause: gateway v1.3.7 introduced a header-folding optimization that interacts badly with our internal reverse proxy; folded multi-line headers >64k could be dropped when proxied to internal lanes. Patch candidate: preserve_custom_headers=true and disable folding for x-idempotency-key, or revert the folding change.

deploy-bot: Rolling patch candidate jamie/disable-header-folding -> staging in 10m, canary to 5% after validation.

jamie-eng: Hotfix notes for docs/ops:
- short-term: enable header passthrough flag on frontends (config: preserve_custom_headers=true) to stop drops
- mid-term: patch gateway to not fold the X-Idempotency-Key header and add an automated test that sends large payload + retry scenarios
- follow-up: add metric for "missing-idempotency-forwarded" (count of requests where ingress had header but upstream lacked it)

ara-support: Customer comms: propose immediate refund/credit for duplicate tokens and explain root cause + mitigation. Billing team, can you prepare credit for invoice ACME-20250312?

billing-bot: Created credit CR_4421 for ACME-20250312 equal to duplicate token charges. Will attach to next invoice and notify customer.

leo-customer: Thanks — customer wants a short RCA they can share with their security team. Can we include repro steps and the timeline?

jamie-eng: I'll draft a short RCA. Timeline: 2025-03-11 22:03 UTC gateway 1.3.7 deploy -> 2025-03-12 10:12 UTC duplicate billing observed -> 2025-03-12 10:45 UTC initial support ticket -> 2025-03-12 11:00 UTC patch to enable preserve_custom_headers in edge -> 2025-03-12 11:30 UTC canary patch -> 2025-03-12 12:00 UTC full patch rollout.

mike-sre: Post-mortem actions assigned: JAMIE -> implement regression test; SRE -> add missing-idempotency-forwarded metric and alert; BILLING -> finalize customer credit; SUPPORT -> send RCA and customer-facing notes.

ara-support: Quick customer-facing blurb (to review): "We found a gateway regression that, for large requests during intermittent connectivity, could drop the X-Idempotency-Key when forwarding to our backend. That meant retries from client SDKs were treated as new requests and resulted in duplicate billing. We've deployed a hotfix and issued a credit. We're adding tests and monitoring to prevent recurrence."

leo-customer: Customer ok with that wording. Thanks all for the quick turnaround :+1:

jamie-eng: PR: https://git.redwood.example/jamie/api-gateway/pull/452 (disable folding for idempotency headers + tests)

mike-sre: Closing note: please link any further affected invoices to Q_875321 so we can ensure no other duplicates slipped through.

ara-support: Closing thread after RCA and credit confirmed.
